leftOut.text: Led the team to 144 client engagements against a target of 116 by giving analysts more autonomy
Built the financial services and automotive analytics teams from scratch in 2023, moving 5 of 6 analysts into new verticals through two reductions in force
Raised the team's thriving score on the employee survey to 71, its highest ever, up 13 points in a year with 100% participation
Coached analysts to 3 promotions and moved much of the team from junior to senior band
Wrote the analytics org's AI strategy, with goals every analyst could track, and won leadership support to roll it out
Taught Microsoft Advertising's analytics community how the team uses AI, and coached analysts to use LLMs for analysis they couldn't do before
Built a prototype marketplace monitor in SQL on Microsoft Fabric that scores daily advertiser spend from normal to anomalous across 6 business contexts, with a metric developed using AI
Added AI-assisted analysis to a weekly business memo and to reports for regional sales VPs that combine performance data with news and financials, then taught the method org-wide
